title.narrative: Combating modern slavery in mining sites in North and South Kivu

description.narrative: Project to combat modern slavery in minings sites in North and South Kivu, DR Congo. All activities supported through the project are being implemented through a gender sensitive lens to directly benefit women, girls, men and vulnerable groups. In addition to girls and women, behavior change communication interventions also target men with gender sensitive messaging. Community members are of both genders to ensure messaging reaches all parts of the community. The project should therefore have a positive impact on women’s rights and gender equality. Especially: ? IOM’s project has a focus on assisting vulnerable women in mining areas. ? In the workshops and trainings organized, IOM will try to ensure participation from both men and women. In the modules of the trainings and workshops, equality and women’s rights will be highlighted. ? For the support to victims of trafficking, IOM will ensure the full participation of female beneficiaries.

5.c - Adopt and strengthen sound policies and enforceable legislation for the promotion of gender equality and the empowerment of all women and girls at all levels

8.7 - Take immediate and effective measures to eradicate forced labour, end modern slavery and human trafficking and secure the prohibition and elimination of the worst forms of child labour, including recruitment and use of child soldiers, and by 2025 end child labour in all its forms
